items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow (no fracture), ruled OUT, expected to miss time (last instance ~month). Additional testing Monday.
items.why: Quinn confirmed dislocation; X-rays negative; Rap/Schefter.
items.implication: Mariota starts; multi-week absence likely impacts WRs ROS.
items.opportunity: Short-term QB stream; WR volume may shift.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE for Week 2 vs Raiders.
items.why: Schefter confirmation; Rapoport bullish tone earlier on optimism/flak jacket possible.
items.implication: Start with possible volume docks from rib; main target if limited.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets primary if healthy enough; reverse prior backups.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive today.
items.why: Official inactive; ETR/Levitan noted not expected.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for backups in committee.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) true game-time decision for MNF; missed practices.
items.why: Levitan/ETR notes true GTD; Schefter pre-game decision, trending uncertain.
items.implication: Have pivot ready; if out Adams/TE heavy.
items.opportunity: If IN full WR1; if OUT elevated for Davante Adams/others.

items.text: Raiders HC Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers: “Close, very close. He looks great.” Optimistic for Week 3 return after missing W1-2 (knee).
items.why: Postgame HC comments; Rap earlier could return next week.
items.implication: Stash priority; elite TE upside imminent.
items.opportunity: Full TE1 role imminent if cleared.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Caleb Williams (hamstring), Jayden Daniels (dislocated elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Mike Evans (hip not serious), Jayden Reed (head), others (Brooks groin, Dowdle toe, Dobbins hamstring, Goedert knee).
items.why: Long postgame list; Levitan notes one of longer Sundays.
items.opportunity: Backups elevate if OUT (e.g. for Barkley, Williams).

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive (grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason). Agrees Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.implication: Immediate adds for backups; start McConkey.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is ACTIVE; expected clean.
items.why: Schefter active list; Levitan no real docks, sounds fine.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) is ACTIVE vs Texans.
items.why: Official active; Rapoport confirmed will play.
items.implication: Full offense online for Chase/Higgins etc.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks (Rap bullish); Puka true GTD; Olave clean no docks; Harvey->Coleman look; Pittman->Bernard.
items.why: Player-specific: docks for rib, clean for Olave, backup looks.
items.opportunity: McConkey volume if active; clear paths for Coleman/Bernard.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT.
items.why: Weekend reports summary; Rapoport notes opens door for Bateman.
items.implication: Clear WR1 targets to others; stash/handcuff related.

items.why: ETR summary; Levitan expects look at Germie Bernard.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba 9/155/3 TDs; fifth WR ever with 8+ catches/120+ yds/TD in each of first two games.
items.implication: WR1 lock ROS; elite target share.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) questionable to return.
